<div class="prose-hero-tag">The sprawl that swallowed the American Midwest.</div>

The '''GLMZ''', the Great Lakes Metropolitan Zone, is one city wrapped around the bottom of the Great Lakes, from Milwaukee to the Cleveland lakefront, and since both American coastlines fell (nobody can tell you why) it is the hub of the world. Nobody who lives there calls it the GLMZ except on a form. On the street it's ''the zone'', or just ''the city''.

The towers, Struts and arcologies hug the shore and climb toward Chicago, where the money and the height live. At the bottom of the stack, where daylight gives up, are the Glooms. The police ended in a single night in 2096, when Arcturus security took all twenty-three precincts, and the corponations have run things ever since. Schism zones open where the world stops behaving the way it should. Something called the Deep lives in the network, with no origin and no creator.

These are the stories of the people working the seams of it all: ghosts and fixers, medics and actuaries, couriers, cops who aren't cops, and things that were built to dig. Every book is here to read, and every name in them leads somewhere.
